messages:
Maya: hi team — day 2 and running into the usual newbie chaos. quick map request: where do I post (1) repo access requests, (2) VPN/infra access, (3) intro/welcome, (4) doc edits? also which bots should I kick off vs pinging humans?
Alex: welcome!! short answers: intros -> #new-hires (post a quick bio + timezone) :wave:; repo access -> open a thread in #eng with @Sam and include repo name; infra/VPN -> #eng-infra or @OnboardBot; doc edits -> open a PR in the repo and post a link in #docs.
OnboardBot: Hey Maya — you can self-serve many requests. Use `/request-access` in #eng-infra with the payload below:
```
/request-access resource=github:redwood-inference/<repo> reason="dev setup" owner=@Sam
```
That will ping the approvals queue and CC the oncall.
Lina: to expand: for anything customer-facing (support, prod incidents) use #support or #incidents depending on severity. For tooling questions (CI, build failures) use #eng-infra. If you need specific person help, ping them in the channel instead of DMing first.
Jordan: bots to know: @OnboardBot handles access provisioning and invites; @InfraBot handles VM and GCP project requests; @DeployBot posts deploys to #eng-releases. For hardware or seat requests, ping @PeopleOps in #people-ops.
Maya: ok nice — who is Sam? should I @Sam in the repo request message?
Sam: hi Maya — yep, @Sam is me. If you add me to the thread with the repo name I can triage faster. tip: include your github handle + purpose (e.g., "triage, dev local").
Maya: perfect, doing that now. for docs PRs, is there a label we prefer?
Alex: use `docs` label and add a short summary in the PR body with links to any internal design notes. Then drop the PR link in #docs and @DocsOwls if you want a quick review.
Maya: thank you all! this is way less mysterious :tada:
Lina: tiny etiquette note — when asking for access, put the exact resource path and expiry needs. eg: "github:redwood-inference/model-serving, until EOD 3/30" saves back-and-forth.
Jordan: also — prefer public channel threads for access requests so others see ongoing approvals (helps audits). If something is sensitive, mark it and DM security.
Maya: noted. last q — do we have a checklist for day 1/2 I can follow?
OnboardBot: You can run `@OnboardBot checklist show @Maya` or visit https://intranet/redwood/onboarding for the canonical list.
Maya: awesome, I'll run the checklist now. thanks everyone!
